title: TextEDA IR v0.6 — common definitions
description: Scalars, identity patterns and unit conventions shared by all shards. The field-name suffix is the unit: _nm nanometers, _mdeg millidegrees, _mohm milliohms, _uv microvolts, _na nanoamps, _uw microwatts, _mhz millihertz, _mdegc millidegrees Celsius, _ppm parts per million, _uohm microohms, _ff femtofarads, _ph picohenries. Rules: docs/adr/0008-ir-shard-identity-and-hash.md.

format_version.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard, in canonical form (the patch component is left out when it is zero); see teda.md §13.

slug.description: Shape of component_id / board_id / view page_id / system_id / variant id.

lib_id.description: Library name (the table name of [libs.<name>] in project.toml); underscores allowed, e.g. project.

refdes.description: Reference designator, e.g. U1, R10; unique within the board-level namespace.

instance_id.description: Instance id of the board's flat list: U1. An instance of a module carries the module's prefix: <module_instance_id>.<refdes> (M1.U1). This is the identity key; see ADR-0008 decision 3 and ADR-0026 decision 2.

net_id.description: The net name is the identity key: GND, VFB. A net of a module carries the module's prefix: <module_instance_id>.<net> (M1.VFB).

pad_ref.description: Pad reference in pcb, same shape as pin_ref; the pad number comes from the footprint.

device_ref.description: Device id: bare for a device this project owns, `lib:id` for one from a vendored library. The library name and the id have the shapes they have everywhere else.

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

value.description: The unit is determined by the type declared in the component's params section (resistance→µΩ etc.; see ADR-0008 decision 4).

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

text.description: Non-numeric value of a parameter, e.g. a part description.

layer_name.description: Layer name, e.g. F.Cu, F.Mask, B.SilkS.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal form of a SHA-256 digest.

source_ref.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

file.description: Source-file path relative to the project root, e.g. design/sch/charger-buck.teda. Never an absolute path.

line.description: Line number of this object in the source file, 1-based.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute (ADR-0004 rule 8).

proxy_line.description: Starting line of this object in the source file, for diagnostic locations.
